$comment: The current eulogies that commemorate each Wikidata item: a eulogy of the 2004 Latin or Italian edition that lists the person (in data/persons.json, or in a mark of data/mentions_curated.json, its other persons included) without role "mentioned", identified in data/person_items.json (auto or reviewed). A eulogy that mentions the item is never listed for it. Generated by scripts/extract_mentions.py; the commemorated_in of a mentioned person's marks in data/mentions.json.
